turns.speaker: p1
turns.quote: I’ll not dirty my hands just

turns.speaker: p1
turns.quote: because it suits our needs.

turns.speaker: p2
turns.quote: Would your hands be any cleaner if

turns.speaker: p2
turns.quote: we left them here to die? We’re

turns.speaker: p2
turns.quote: the only hope they’ve got. We need

turns.speaker: p2
turns.quote: them and we’ll take them with us.

turns.speaker: p1
turns.quote: But we’ve got to report it--

turns.speaker: p2
turns.quote: To whom, Corporal? To WHOM? Have

turns.speaker: p2
turns.quote: you taken a look around--do you see

turns.speaker: p2
turns.quote: where we are?

turns.speaker: p2
turns.quote: I promise you, their story shall

turns.speaker: p2
turns.quote: not go untold if we survive. I

turns.speaker: p2
turns.quote: promise you that.

turns.speaker: p1
turns.quote: Just as it’s always been. One

turns.speaker: p1
turns.quote: group gets the sugar, the other one

turns.speaker: p1
turns.quote: gets the shit.

turns.speaker: p1
turns.quote: Here. Is your very own handmade

turns.speaker: p1
turns.quote: rifle. A Martini-Henry. Well

turns.speaker: p1
turns.quote: done.

turns.speaker: p3
turns.quote: the river.

turns.speaker: p2
turns.quote: Can you show me where we’re to

turns.speaker: p2
turns.quote: pitch camp tonight?

turns.speaker: p4
turns.quote: Long time on the river before stop.

turns.speaker: p2
turns.quote: The river shall be our home for the

turns.speaker: p2
turns.quote: next two years and we’ll not turn

turns.speaker: p2
turns.quote: back. Twelve hours a day and no

turns.speaker: p2
turns.quote: less.

turns.speaker: p3
turns.quote: They’ll shock you to death, those

turns.speaker: p3
turns.quote: things. Other fish, the candiru--

turns.speaker: p3
turns.quote: they’ll swim right up your johnson--

turns.speaker: p3
turns.quote: so don’t never be letting loose in

turns.speaker: p1
turns.quote: And fuck the bloody Boche!

turns.speaker: p2
turns.quote: Come on!    Come on! Come on!

turns.speaker: p1
turns.quote: Incoming!    Gas!

turns.speaker: p2
turns.quote: Let me kiss you all.

turns.speaker: p2
turns.quote: Joan, and Brian...where’s Jack?

turns.speaker: p5
turns.quote: Here, father.

turns.speaker: p2
turns.quote: What’s...happened to me...?

turns.speaker: p6
turns.quote: They say you’ve been exposed to

turns.speaker: p6
turns.quote: chlorine gas. Your eyes were

turns.speaker: p6
turns.quote: affected, but with any luck, your

turns.speaker: p6
turns.quote: sight shall return. And--you’re

turns.speaker: p6
turns.quote: here, darling. You’re with us, and

turns.speaker: p6
turns.quote: that is what matters.

turns.speaker: p6
turns.quote: Mr. Costin was unhurt. As for your

turns.speaker: p6
turns.quote: division, they suffered many losses-

turns.speaker: p6
turns.quote: -but far fewer than others. It is

turns.speaker: p6
turns.quote: the most death in the history of

turns.speaker: p6
turns.quote: any battle.

turns.speaker: p6
turns.quote: But darling, because of your

turns.speaker: p6
turns.quote: bravery, the Germans have

turns.speaker: p6
turns.quote: retreated, all along the front.

turns.speaker: p6
turns.quote: We’ve made His Majesty aware of

turns.speaker: p6
turns.quote: what you’ve done.

turns.speaker: p6
turns.quote: And they’re going to award you with

turns.speaker: p6
turns.quote: the distinguished service order.

turns.speaker: p6
turns.quote: They’ve also agreed to raise your

turns.speaker: p6
turns.quote: rank to Lieutenant Colonel.
